patterns.note: The oversized hero element (a large pink 'H') scales down significantly and repositions to the top-right corner of the viewport as the user scrolls, becoming a persistent, subtle brand mark.
The hero text dynamically changes from 'Hello.' to 'Bye.' as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
The site uses a dark mode aesthetic with a predominantly black background and high-contrast white typography, punctuated by a single vibrant accent color.
Headings are characterized by extremely large, bold, and modern sans-serif typography, creating strong visual impact and hierarchy.
The 'Our work' section features a dynamic, masonry-like grid of case study previews, each with an image and concise text, that appears to reveal on scroll.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a video-hero element that animates a large 3D object (the 'H') and text. On scroll, the 3D object scales down and translates to a fixed position in the top-right, while the hero text transitions to a different phrase. Subsequent content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a sense of progressive disclosure.
A sticky navigation bar maintains its initial appearance and position at the top of the viewport after the initial scroll, providing consistent access to site navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold hero text (~5-6x body) with subsequent headings maintaining a strong, impactful presence, decreasing in size but retaining a heavy weight.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero and main section titles, creating significant breathing room, transitioning to a more balanced density within content blocks and grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the highly interactive and playful hero animation, where a large 3D brand element dynamically shrinks and repositions on scroll, accompanied by a clever text transition from 'Hello.' to 'Bye.', transforming the initial scroll into a memorable brand interaction.
